shows.title: Physical Mediumship / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Joining guest host Rich Berra (email), physical and mental medium, author, and speaker Julie Adreani will discuss her work in physical mediumship under red light. She’ll explore the role of a trusted, dedicated circle and describe séance phenomena, including transfiguration and other forms of spirit activity. She'll also share her journey into mediumship, her training, and personal encounters involving spirits and extraterrestrials. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Rich a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!

shows.title: Hauntings & Halloween / Apports & Anomalies
shows.first_half: First Half: Joining Richard Syrett, psychic medium Ericka Boussarhane will discuss communicating with spirits, investigating haunted locations, exploring paranormal activity, and the origins of Halloween. Followed by journalist Keith Thompson, who will explore anomalous events that challenge our understanding of reality, from mysteriously transported objects and telepathic communication to apparitions of the departed, spontaneous healings, and UFO encounters.
shows.second_half: 6-10pm PT: Art Bell - Somewhere in Time returns to 8/15/96, when William Pierce discussed his controversial novel The Turner Diaries.

shows.title: Geoengineering & Climate / Ancient Wisdom
shows.first_half: First Half: Researcher Peter A. Kirby joins Richard Syrett to explore the origins behind modern geoengineering claims, and the growing anti-geoengineering movement. Drawing on his upcoming book, Who Is Spraying Us?, he’ll examine the individuals and institutions he believes are driving these programs, along with debates over weather modification.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Psychic, astrologer, and life coach Holly Hall will discuss consciousness, ancient wisdom, astrology, and humanity’s spiritual evolution. Topics include the Kali Yuga, the coming Golden Age, ancient civilizations, and the hidden influences shaping human awareness.

shows.title: Space Exploration / Astrology Cycles
shows.first_half: First Half: Space historian Rod Pyle will examine the future of space exploration, including lunar missions, a Mars sample return, SpaceX’s Starship, China’s space program, and the growing role of commercial spaceflight. He’ll also look at 60 years of Star Trek’s influence on science and innovation.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Astrologer and radio host Mark Lerner will discuss major new and full moon cycles, Venus and Mercury retrogrades, and their potential implications for love, finances, and personal growth. He’ll also delve into the lore of Friday the 13th, and planetary patterns influencing world events and humanity’s future.

shows.title: Atlantis & Lemuria / Connecting with ET Consciousness
shows.guests: Tom T. Moore, Rebecca Hardcastle Wright
shows.first_half: First Half: Author, telepath, and bestselling self-help author Tom T. Moore will explore the lost civilizations of Atlantis and Lemuria, their legendary advanced cultures, and the events believed to have led to their disappearance.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Researcher and author Rebecca Hardcastle Wright will discuss exoconsciousness, the human ability to connect and co-create with extraterrestrial, multidimensional, and spiritual beings. She’ll explore the implications of such encounters, along with plasma science, UAP phenomena, and how humanity might prepare for future contact.

shows.title: Individual Liberties / Big Pharma & Public Health
shows.first_half: First Half: Author G. Edward Griffin will examine what he sees as a major flaw in modern politics: the lack of agreement on government's proper role. He’ll explain why he believes protecting individual liberty requires principles that limit state power, rather than reliance on political parties or personalities.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Constitutional attorney Jonathan Emord will explore how FDA regulations and the Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act may affect pharmaceutical competition, drug monopolies, and access to health and nutrition information. He’ll also discuss concerns about regulatory practices and their role in the chronic disease epidemic.

shows.title: AI & Humanity's Evolution / Near-Death Revelations
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Matthew James Bailey will explore how AI has brought humanity to an evolutionary crossroads and why he believes a hopeful future lies beyond doomsday predictions. He’ll distinguish AI from true intelligence and examine what this reveals about human consciousness.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Near-death experience researcher and radiation oncologist Dr. Jeffrey Long will explore what thousands of NDEs may reveal about consciousness, God, and life after death. He’ll discuss out-of-body awareness, encounters with deceased loved ones, spiritual experiences, and the lasting transformations those who have experienced them report.

shows.title: Hauntings & Premonitions / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Author and paranormal podcaster Jim Harold joins guest host Rich Berra (email) for a conversation about hauntings and shadow figures, messages from deceased loved ones, premonitions, and encounters with mysterious creatures. Over two decades of talking with witnesses and paranormal researchers, Harold has heard stories that raise questions about what happens after death, whether certain places retain an imprint of the past, and what may be lurking beyond our everyday reality. Open Lines follow in the latter half. Give Rich a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!
